messages:
Sam (AE): Velora procurement asked for SIG v3 Q-by-Q + attachments. Deadline Thu EOD. They specifically called out ENCR and ACCESS as blockers.
Ivy (Security): Got it. Do they want SOC2 or just evidence snippets per question?
Sam (AE): They want answers for all SIG questions but only attachments for ENCR/KEY/ACCESS/INFRA.
Diego (Solutions): I can assemble mapping. ETA tomorrow 9am. Which artifacts must be included?
Ivy (Security): Minimum: redacted SOC2 cover sheet, KMS policy, key rotation runbook excerpt, encryption-at-rest configs (DB and blob storage), SCIM/SSO sample, and private deployment network diagram. Also a vuln scan summary.
Maya (Legal): Reminder: redact tenant IDs and internal IPs. We'll need a signed DPA before sharing full SOC2. Use secure-share with one-week TTL.
evidence-bot: Uploaded: soc2_cover_redacted.pdf, kms_policy_2025.pdf, rotation_runbook_snip.txt, vuln_scan_may2025.pdf
Diego (Solutions): Draft answer for SIG 3.2.1 (key ownership): "Customers can use customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). Onboarding steps and rotation procedures are provided by SRE." Good?
Ivy (Security): Fine. Add: "rotations can be performed without expected service disruption when following runbook." Don't promise zero downtime.
Sam (AE): They also asked whether we support tenant isolation for EU-only data.
Ivy (Security): Confirm yes — via Private deployment or Dedicated with region pinning. I'll attach a screenshot of the region selector and a short note: "EU-only residency supported with contractual controls."
Maya (Legal): If they request HSM custody, we'll need an addendum. I'll draft language.
Diego (Solutions): I'll finalize mapping doc (velora_sig_map_v1.xlsx) and prepare final bundle. Plan: Ivy+Diego finalize by Thu 12pm, Legal to send DPA same morning, Sam to deliver post-review.
Sam (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll queue secure-share once I get the DPA. :pray:
